question_types_in_exam.summary: UP Board Class 12 Sociology mein 4 types: MCQ (1 mark), VSA (3 marks, 25 words), SA (6 marks, 50 words), LA (8 marks with OR, 150 words). NO map, NO dates, NO practical.

types.mostly_from: Sare 10 attempt karo — no negative marking. MCQ mostly: 'Author of book X?', 'Who gave concept of Y?', 'When was Z established?', 'Main characteristic of W?' — theorist/concept pairs memorise karo.
types.notes: Sare 10 attempt karo — no negative marking. MCQ mostly: 'Author of book X?', 'Who gave concept of Y?', 'When was Z established?', 'Main characteristic of W?' — theorist/concept pairs memorise karo.

types.mostly_from: 10 VSA × 3 = 30 marks — SABSE IMPORTANT section. 3-4 lines mein complete definition + 1 example ya feature. 'Define X', 'What do you mean by Y', 'Write types of Z' type.
types.notes: 10 VSA × 3 = 30 marks — SABSE IMPORTANT section. 3-4 lines mein complete definition + 1 example ya feature. 'Define X', 'What do you mean by Y', 'Write types of Z' type.

types.mostly_from: 50 words mein 5-6 lines — intro (1 line) + 3-4 numbered points (3-4 lines) + conclusion (1 line). 'Discuss X', 'Describe Y', 'Explain Z' — structured answer.
types.notes: 50 words mein 5-6 lines — intro (1 line) + 3-4 numbered points (3-4 lines) + conclusion (1 line). 'Discuss X', 'Describe Y', 'Explain Z' — structured answer.

types.mostly_from: 150 words = 12-15 lines. Intro para + 4-5 sub-points with sub-headings + conclusion. OR option ka fayda uthao — dono dekho, easier pick karo. Diagrams/flowcharts optional but presentation helps.

theorists_and_concepts_masterlist.note: Sociology ke MCQ (10 marks) aur VSA (30 marks) mein 70% questions theorist + concept pairs par based hote hain. Ye Sociology ka 'named reactions' / 'historical dates' equivalent hai — UP Board ka scoring backbone. 40+ theorists yaad karo.

foundational_sociologists.key_contributions: Father of Sociology; coined term 'Sociology' (1838); Law of Three Stages
Social facts; Division of Labour in Society; Suicide (4 types); Mechanical vs Organic solidarity
Verstehen (understanding); Bureaucracy; Protestant Ethic and Spirit of Capitalism; Authority types (traditional/charismatic/legal-rational)
Class conflict; Historical materialism; Capitalism-Socialism-Communism; Alienation
Social Darwinism; Organic analogy; Survival of the fittest applied to society
Social change types — Ideational, Sensational/Sensate, Idealistic (MCQ asked 2023); Social and Cultural Dynamics
'Essay on Population' (1798); Population grows geometrically (1,2,4,8) but food arithmetically (1,2,3,4); positive + preventive checks — MCQ asked EVERY year
'Culture is the man-made part of the environment' — MCQ asked 2023 AND 2024

indian_sociologists.key_contributions: Sanskritization (1952); Westernization; Dominant Caste; 'Remembered Village'; Religion and Society among Coorgs — MCQ 2023
Father of Indian Sociology; 'Caste and Race in India'; Tribe as 'backward Hindu'
Marxist perspective on Indian society; 'Social Background of Indian Nationalism'
Annihilation of Caste; Dalit movement foundation; Constitution drafting
Caste, class, power in Tanjore village

other_theorists_mcq_relevant.key_contributions: 'Caste is a closed class' — MCQ 2023; 'Society: An Introductory Analysis'
Chipko Movement — MCQ 2024; 'Ecology is permanent economy'
Khejarli tree protection 1730 — historical precursor to Chipko

important_formula_sheets.note: Not typically applicable for Sociology (humanities subject).

most_scoring_sections: Easy — 7-9 sahi easily. Theorist-concept pairs ratte ho toh 9-10 out of 10.
Easy — definitions 25 words mein. 8-9 attempt = 24-27 marks. Highest ROI section.

tips: VSA (Q11-Q20) mein 30 marks hain — SABSE PEHLE focus yahan do. Har definition mein theorist ka naam shamil karo.
Theorist-concept pairs ki ek table banao — 40+ pairs. Revision ke time 2-3 baar dohra lo.
MCQ mein 'author of book X' questions — Essay on Population = Malthus, Sanskritization = Srinivas. Ratte-chipkao style.
LA mein OR option ka smart use — Q27 mein Green Revolution pakka prepare karke jao (ye 2023, 2024 DONO mein aaya). Q28 mein Dowry pakka karke jao.
Green Revolution aur Dowry — ye 2 topics toh ANNUALLY aate hain. 150-word ready answer memorize karo.
Indian examples do — Punjab-Haryana for Green Revolution, Kerala for literacy, Punjab for migration, Maharashtra for Narmada.
Chipko Movement: MCQ answer = Sunderlal Bahuguna (Chandi Prasad Bhatt bhi co-leader). Historical precursor Amrita Devi Bishnoi 1730 — ye factual detail bonus.
Panchayati Raj — 73rd Amendment 1992, 3-tier structure, Gram Pradhan as chairman — VSA/SA mein zaroor aata hai.
Hindi/English mixed OK — terms English mein (Sanskritization, Verstehen, Demography), explanation Hindi mein.
Clean handwriting UP Board mein important — neat presentation ke alag marks.
Q29 women's movements agar aaye toh 3 waves batao: 1st wave (19th cent social reform), 2nd wave (1970s equality), 3rd wave (diverse).

time_allocation.note: Paper pura padho. Q27/28/29 OR options dono dekho, decide which to attempt. VSA ke terms mental mein draft karo.
10 MCQ × 1.2 min. Theorist-concept direct match. No negative marking.
10 VSA × 4 min. 25 words = 3-4 lines. SABSE HIGH WEIGHT — 30 marks!
6 SA × 10 min. 50 words = 5-6 lines. Heading + 3-4 points + conclusion.
3 LA × 17 min. 150 words = 12-15 lines. Intro + sub-headings + conclusion.
Check question numbers, theorist attributions, handwriting clarity.

targets.strategy: MCQ 7-8 (~8 marks) + VSA 6-7 (~18-21 marks) + SA 2-3 (~12-18 marks) = 38-47 marks. Safe pass.
focus_areas: MCQ — theorist-concept pairs (Malthus, Srinivas, Herskovits, Sorokin, McIver) = 4-5 questions easily
VSA — 10 common definitions: Class, Kinship, Tribe, Urbanisation, Social change, Liberalization, Divyang, Communalism, Regionalism, Pressure group = 30 marks opportunity
SA — Green Revolution, Land reforms, Gram Panchayat, Dowry — any 2-3 of these prepared toh 12-18 marks pakke
LA — SKIP if time short, OR do one easy LA (Dowry OR Green Revolution)
VSA all 10 definitions master karo — 30 marks

SA — prepare: Green Revolution, Land reforms, Gram Panchayat, Women's movements, Tribal movements, Environmental movements, Unity in diversity, Indian democracy, Interview methodology, Survey methodology
LA — ALL 3 attempt with OR option used smartly. Focus on: Green Revolution, Dowry, Women's movements, Mass media
All 15 units mastered with theorist attributions

LA — 6 topics fully prepared (Green Revolution, Dowry, Women's, Tribal, Peasant, Industrial society)

exam_day_rules.extra_time_note: 15 minute reading time — likhna allowed nahi is time mein.

answer_sheet_rules: sequence_note: Sequence follow karna zaroori nahi — MCQ pehle attempt karo, phir VSA easy ones, phir SA, phir LA.
mcq_attempt_all: Sare 10 MCQ attempt karo — no negative. Theorist-concept pairs yaad hon toh 8-9 MCQ easily correct.

vsa_high_weight: Q11-Q20 (30 marks) — HIGHEST single weight. Definitions mein theorist ka naam zaroor include karo. E.g., 'Sanskritization — M.N. Srinivas ne prastut kiya. Ye wo prakriya hai jisme lower caste upper caste ke reeti-riwaz apnakar apna social status badhati hai.'

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Black'] pencil_use: Sociology mein pencil ki zaroorat barely hoti hai. Agar flowchart/diagram banana ho (e.g., kinship chart, demographic transition curve) toh pencil OK.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: word_limits: 25 / 50 / 150 — respect karo. Sociology UP Board mein word limit strict hai — zyada likhne se presentation down. headings_subheadings: SA mein 3-4 numbered points. LA mein 4-5 sub-headings + intro + conclusion. theorist_attribution: Hamesha concept ke saath theorist ka naam likho (e.g., 'Sanskritization — M.N. Srinivas', 'Caste as closed class — McIver aur Page'). Examiner ko dikhna chahiye. examples_in_answers: Indian context ke examples do — UP/Bihar tribal communities, Punjab Green Revolution, Narmada Bachao etc. partial_marking: True partial_marking_note: Har point separately evaluate hota hai — ek galat point se baaki cut nahi. hindi_english_mix: Technical terms English mein (Sanskritization, Westernization, Liberalization, Demography) + explanation Hindi mein — common and acceptable.
